title: In-Transit Data Transport Strategies for Coupled AI-Simulation Workflow Patterns
problem: Coupled AI-Simulation workflows lack tools for performance analysis and prototyping of in-situ data transport
motivation: HPC facilities need benchmarking tools for coupled workflows to identify data transport bottlenecks
method: SimAI-Bench is a benchmarking tool that tests data movement between AI systems and simulations running together, addressing a gap in tools for analyzing performance in these coupled workflows. It evaluates two patterns: one-to-one setups where an AI system and simulation share the same hardware (colocated), and many-to-one (ensemble) setups where multiple simulations send data to a single AI system. By measuring how efficiently data transports between these components on the Aurora supercomputer, the tool helps researchers identify and prototype solutions for performance bottlenecks.
key_novelty: SimAI-Bench enables performance testing of data transport in coupled AI-simulation workflows and demonstrates the performance advantage of DragonHPC for this purpose.
contributions: Analysis of one-to-one pattern: node-local and DragonHPC superior
